{{Top|leg}}
'''Bacta numb''' was a form of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] that acted as a [[Wikipedia:topical anesthetic|topical anesthetic]]. It numbed the area it was injected into, and was often included in field medical kits to use in emergencies.
